{{Quote|Think of Offense as a dagger saved in reserve for a fatal thrust.|[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], ''[[Book of Sith]]''|<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Offense''' was one of the three schools, or focuses, of combat using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as taught by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. It encompassed [[Force power/Legends|powers]] that could be easily and immediately applied with little exertion and that had applications for [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. Offense skills included [[Inertia]], [[Force blinding|Blind]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|Push]], Choke, and Throw.<ref name="Book of Sith" />
